summary.text: David Redkey is the Green Party nominee for Arizona's 3rd Congressional District. He is a certified teacher who describes himself as a public-school teacher, small business owner and disability advocate, and he is focused on conservatorship reform and what he calls "Foundational Economics."

paragraphs.text: Redkey was born in Bloomington, Indiana, and attended Sunnyslope High School. He earned an associate degree from Glendale Community College in 2014, a bachelor's degree from Arizona State University in 2016, a master's degree from Arizona State University in 2019 and a graduate certificate from Northern Arizona University in 2023.
His campaign website says he has called Arizona home for nearly four decades. He says he lives there with his wife and son.

Redkey runs TBI Writer LLC. He says his experience with the Arizona probate system after a debilitating injury led him to advocate for conservatorship reform, and that he serves as director of Clean Up Our Courts Arizona.
He also sought the Green Party nomination in the 1st District. He advanced as the Green nominee for the 3rd District in the July 21, 2026 primary as a write-in candidate with 5 votes.
